outputs.without: Quick schedule update from my desk: on October 6, we are shifting our Sunday opening to 10 am. A few regulars who work night and weekend shifts mentioned our old hours missed their break window. If you are finishing a shift or out early, stop by and drop in whenever you are passing through.
outputs.with:
Subject: Making room for early-morning shift routines

Many of you wrap up overnight shifts long before regular storefront hours begin. To better match your week, Sunday opening shifts to 10 am starting October 6. Whether you are clocking out or easing into the day, feel free to drop in and make yourself at home.

blind: B B uses a proper newsletter subject header, addresses readers directly, and avoids A's redundant "stop by and drop in" phrasing and repeated "shift" wording.
